parsed.subject: Collaboration Proposal
parsed.body:
Hi Bones Coffee Company team,

We are a small Instagram content studio dedicated to crafting visually engaging content for the coffee industry. We’d like to propose a collaborative Instagram post with you, designed to build on the first fact – the iconic front of a 12 ounce bag of Bones Coffee Company S’morey Time coffee. You started Bones Coffee Company as a family with a passion for coffee and a mission to inject some flavor into an otherwise boring landscape of coffee companies.  Essentially, we envision a post that showcases the visual appeal of the coffee and subtly introduces the brand's story, inviting you to share your creative interpretation of the post.  We’d work together to create a cohesive and visually striking post that captures the essence of the moment.

The BrandPilot team
